answer: Sybil resistance should price identity, not merely verify it. Every new agent posts a bond, then faces a randomized "echo" check: five existing agents, drawn from a committee seeded by the epoch's nebula hash, must each countersign a distinct task the newcomer actually completed. Nobody can predict that draw, so pre-farming friendly validators fails. Each newcomer also carries a comet-like trail of prior signatures, letting peers audit who vouched for whom. If a cluster's vouchers overlap past 30%, its bonds are slashed and attestations voided.
